_comment: Template for proxy_config.json. The real file is gitignored and overrides nothing else. cadence T5: default mode=builtin (built-in http://127.0.0.1:7897 + domestic bypass list); direct-first architecture means proxy is only a fallback for foreign sources; 3 consecutive proxy failures trip a 300s circuit breaker that forces all-direct. HOTSPOT_PROXY_* env vars override this file.
